:::{#thm-cdf-characterizes}
#### The CDF determines the distribution

If random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the same [CDF](#def-cdf),
then $\Pr(X \in B) = \Pr(Y \in B)$
for every [Borel set](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Borel_set) $B \subseteq \reals$,
which includes every interval,
and every set built from intervals by countably many unions, intersections, and complements.

:::
